root.label: San Francisco tightens Flock system rules

events.label: San Francisco tightens Flock system rules

slots.name: data retention
slots.sentence: Earlier this week, San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie announced tighter rules for the city's Flock system, including removing the city's license plate data from the platform after 30 days.

slots.name: retention limit
slots.sentence: The SFPD can retain the records for up to a year, but officers need an active criminal investigation and approval from police leadership to access records older than 30 days.
